description: The SEMANTICS faculty's COMPREHENSION piece (associative_recall — pattern-completion to the semantic neighbourhood), graph-native. Binding gives the form a meaning node; comprehension USES it: the recognised form completes to its PLACE in the writing system (its script/alphabet) and its FAMILIARITY (a meaning recalled by >=2 marks is a known/repeated symbol — the attractor activated again). Two Rules over the meaning network; comprehension IS the Rules, no Python.

microtheory.name: semantic_comprehension
microtheory.description: comprehend the recognised symbol in its system
